endpoints.title: Stop Ring
endpoints.description: Stops ringing a specific user in a dm call. You must be in the call to use this endpoint, returns NotConnected otherwise. Only valid in DM/Group channels, will return NoEffect in servers. Returns NotFound if the user is not in the dm/group channel

verification.test: voice: a bot gets a LiveKit ticket; force_disconnect is refused

endpoints.title: Join Call
endpoints.description: Asks the voice server for a token to join the call.
restrictions: Bots get IsBot when force_disconnect == Some(true).
The ticket only lets the bot connect to LiveKit; VoiceChannelJoin is sent once it actually joins the room. Bots cannot use force_disconnect.

verification.test: voice: a bot gets a LiveKit ticket; force_disconnect is refused

token.description: Token for authenticating with the voice server

url.description: Url of the livekit server to connect to

node.description: Name of the node to join

force_disconnect.description:
Whether to force disconnect any other existing voice connections

Useful for disconnecting on another device and joining on a new.

recipients.description:
Users which should be notified of the call starting

Only used when the user is the first one connected.

previous_session.description: LiveKit participant session this device had before its connection dropped. The join is refused (`AlreadyConnected`) when another session of the user has taken the seat since, so a device coming back online does not push out the newer one.
